name: Emil Barna
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: Emil is a psychotherapist, writer, and podcaster who specialises in treating addiction, anxiety, stress, the impacts of trauma. He is also passionate about helping people improve their confidence in navigating daily struggles. His research interests include post-traumatic stress, the human stress response, confidence-building, and self-awareness.
specialties: Posttraumatic stress disorder, Trauma recovery, Somatic psychotherapy

name: Lisa Rebecca
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: Family therapist and Individual Counsellor specialising in the impacts Alcohol and Other Drugs on Families and Supports.

name: Frith Luton
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: I am a Zurich-trained Jungian psychoanalyst, for more see my website at FrithLuton.com Therapy can be both short and longterm and focuses on depth psychological dream interpretation and on bringing meaning to a person’s life through how their symbolic life resonates with reviewing their current life stage and concerns

name: Biliana Dearly
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: I'm a psychotherapist, supervisor, and senior lecturer in Melbourne. I currently lecture and supervise in the Master of Counselling and Psychotherapy Program at the Cairnmillar Institute, work part-time in private practice and deliver Foundation and Certification Programme workshops in Focusing-Oriented Therapy. My work is informed by in-depth and extensive training in humanistic, process-experiential and existential theory and practice and by my on-going commitment to expanding my awareness through the practice of Focusing.
specialties: Posttraumatic stress disorder, Trauma recovery, Somatic psychotherapy

name: Kerrilee Walsingham
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: I am a Registered Clinical Counsellor with 13 years experience. We all find life confusing and difficult to navigate at times and I love to support clients through whatever challenges they are facing.

name: Carol-Ann Allen
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: Psychotherapy can help you respond resourcefully to life, not just react. My practice of psychotherapy is an active collaboration between you and me. Together, we explore the unspoken thoughts or beliefs that limit your choices or shape your behaviour patterns.

name: Janice (Jen) O'Bryan
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Certified Practising)
description: I work primarily with body based therapy using Breathwork. I am passionate about working with the whole person, body, mind, emotions and soul. I believe we need to access more than our mind to work deeply with our feelings, memories and trauma.
specialties: Posttraumatic stress disorder, Trauma recovery, Somatic psychotherapy

name: Adam Szmerling
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: I'm Adam Szmerling, a psychoanalytic psychotherapist and the founder of Bayside Psychotherapy in Highett, with more than 20 years in private practice. I work with adults and couples in person in Highett, close to Brighton, Sandringham and Cheltenham, and online anywhere in Australia. I also draw on schema therapy and Buddhist psychotherapy when they fit.
